vocabularyDefinition.en: Collection of network elements of one type of utility service.

vocabularyUsageNote.en: For example, an electricity network, a sewerage network, a gas network. The network elements in question are, for example, the elements of the network of an internet provider: optical cables arriving in cabinets on the street via multiplexers connected to copper cables to the homes in that street.

vocabularyDefinition.en: Name by which the network is known.
Parties authorized to manage, operate or own the Utility Network.
The type of utility network or the utility network theme.

vocabularyUsageNote.en: Uses the Utility Network Type code list to describe the possible utility networks. This also includes the 'crossTheme' value to be used for utility networks that may contain cables or pipes from different themes, typically used by utility network providers that supply pipes.

vocabularyDefinition.en: Utility Network associated with the Utility Network.
Object describing the connection of a cable or pipe to a building or other physical object.
Physical point-shaped part of the UtilityNetwork.

vocabularyUsageNote.en: Can stand alone as a Utility Node,but is often mounted on a carrier (the Utility Node Container). For example an inspection hatch,a hydrant,a splitter,a meter,a pump etc.
